top_signals.title: Iran says it captured US submarine drone in Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Iran said Tuesday it captured a U.S. uncrewed submarine in the Strait of Hormuz. The Pentagon said it had malfunctioned more than a day ago.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson Says We're Still in a Bull Market
top_signals.summary: Morgan Stanley Chief US Equity Strategist Mike Wilson says we're still in a bull market, but higher oil prices and interest rates are a risk to stocks. He says investors should continue to own energy stocks as a hedge. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: CIA official touts agency’s Cyber Mission Center in capture of Venezuela’s Maduro
top_signals.summary: A "flawless" performance by the CIA's Cyber Mission Center contributed to the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in January, agency Deputy Director Michael Ellis says.
